title: Moderate to heavy rainfall with thunderstorms over the Far North and parts of the North Regions.
summary: The Current moderate rainfall over parts of the Logone and Chari Division of the Far North Region is expected to intensify and extend over the entire Far North Region and the northern part of the North Region, exposing these areas to a moderate risk of flooding in low-lying and flood-prone areas.
